commentary_title: Fresh US sanctions causes frenzy in the VLCC tanker market
commentary_summary: The VLCC-tonne miles index declined last week ending the week at 96.7 points as tonnage demand had been weak in the previous week with less vessels moving underway. | Freight rates on the other hand soared up as the US rolled up with fresh sanction on two major Russian insurers causing mayhem in the oil and tanker markets. Freight rates shot up on most routes even for the smaller tanker segments with routes towards the UKC seeing the highest surge. | The vessel utilisation is likely to increase next week with freight rates continuing to hover around the new levels.
